# GMEOW Music Module

The GMEOW Music Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/music>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/music`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

Frame-relative musical content; every notation is a lossy projection.

This module implements the music extension slice: pitch frames (issue #308),
pitch collections and spelling (issue #309), musical time (issue #310), and the
structure graph (issue #311): MusicalSegment, ToneEvent, Voice, PitchTrajectory,
and SegmentTransformation. Bulk note-level data lives in GTS music-package
bundles, not the reasoned core (Principles 8, 12).

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/music>
